step: Step 2: main test on ADBench (H-CC1 -> H-CC2 -> H-CC3, fixed sequence)
preprocessing: zscore-train (refits: fitted on the kept rows)

cleaning.committee: committee score = mean of the members' cached training scores (fitted on all training rows), each min-max scaled on its training scores; the k = budget_k(q, n_train) highest rows removed, a tie block crossing the cut kept (thesis.cleaning); every member of the ensemble refitted on the kept rows
cleaning.e_bench: E-bench is cleaned by its own committee (IForest, PCA, KNN)
cleaning.self: each member removes the k rows it scores highest itself (same q and tie rule) and is refitted on its own kept rows; SC E-bench fuses the same self-cleaned IForest, PCA and KNN
cleaning.members_after_committee_cleaning: refitted on the E-all committee's kept rows

fusion: min-max fitted on each member's training scores (its kept rows after a refit), then the mean
unit: seed-mean FP@K per dataset (15 datasets), rounded to 9 decimals

H-CC2.decision: not tested (fixed sequence: H-CC1 not rejected)

H-CC3.decision: not tested (fixed sequence: H-CC1 not rejected)

decision_rule_outcome: H-CC1 or H-CC2 not rejected: CC is not added (at most one sentence in Future Work)
note: training labels used only for the descriptive cleaning-quality table; test labels only for FP@K and the oracle references; refits kept in memory, not cached; ADBench only (Step 3 not run)
